title: model-request-scorer-and-deprecation-schedule-playbook
text:
model-request-scorer-and-deprecation-schedule-playbook

description:
Create a repeatable, documented playbook and lightweight implementation for scoring incoming model catalog requests (new model adds, version pinning, deprecations) that prioritizes enterprise requirements. The playbook will include: an intake scoring rubric (numeric score + buckets), automated deprecation scheduling with stakeholder notifications, a default version-pinning policy template for enterprise customers, and minimum eval gate criteria tied to onboarding flows. We will deliver both the policy doc and a minimal PoC scoring service + intake UI changes in the catalog console.

acceptance_criteria:
Numeric scoring rubric defined and documented with weights for enterprise signals (SLA need, data residency, security, performance delta, cost delta, customer demand)
PoC scoring service implemented behind a /triage-score API and integrated into the intake form so every new request is assigned a score and bucket
Deprecation schedule automation defined: triggers, notice windows, partner notifications, and rollback policy documented
Default version-pinning templates created and surfaced in onboarding docs and catalog UI
Eval-gate thresholds specified for three common flows (general-purpose, safety-sensitive, and enterprise-regulated) and linked to onboarding checklist
Design approval for intake UI changes and notification UX obtained
Integration test demonstrating full intake -> score -> pin/deprecation flow exists and runs in staging
PM + Eng + Legal sign-off on enterprise weighting for privacy/regulatory signals

tasks:
Draft scoring rubric and weighting proposal (PM)
Design intake form changes, score display, and deprecation notices (DES)
Build PoC scoring microservice and /triage-score endpoint (ENG)
Wire scoring into existing catalog intake API and console (ENG)
Write version-pinning policy templates and example configs (PM)
Define eval sets and pass thresholds for three onboarding classes (Research/Applied ML)
Create deprecation automation runbook and notification templates (PM + CS)
Write integration tests and smoke tests for staging (ENG)
Coordinate legal/security review for enterprise signals (Legal/Security)
Run cross-functional review and record final playbook in Confluence (PM)
Communicate changes to Solutions and Customer Success with one-pager and FAQ

comments:
2026-03-02 - Asha Patel: Initial ticket created after 3 enterprise requests last quarter where model pinning and deprecation expectations caused deployment delays. Goal is to reduce triage time and standardize decisions.
2026-03-03 - Miguel Santos: Spoke with ENG infra and they estimate ~2 sprint work to build the PoC endpoint and attach it to intake. Will scope minimal schema for scores.
2026-03-04 - Claire Ng (Design): Uploaded first mockups for intake UX and deprecation banner. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MC/Intake-UX-Mockups
2026-03-04 - Legal (K. Horowitz): Requested that any enterprise scoring that uses data residency or compliance as a factor be documented and auditable. Added as dependency for security review.
2026-03-05 - Miguel Santos: Created draft PR for /triage-score PoC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/876. It's backend-only for now; will return score payload {score:int, bucket:string, reasons:[]}.
2026-03-05 - Asha Patel: Added sample customer-facing FAQ and notification cadence to Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MC/Deprecation-Playbook-Draft

decisions:
Use a 0-100 numeric score; >=75 = High priority, 50-74 = Medium, <50 = Low
Enterprise signals (data residency, SLA need, contractual requirement) have +30 weight cap; safety/regulatory flags are binary blockers that trigger manual review
Deprecation default notice window = 90 days for hosted models, 180 days for dedicated/private customers (configurable per-customer)
Default version pinning template will set 'pin_to_model_version' and 'fallback_policy' fields in intake schema
Eval gates enforced for enterprise-regulated class: model must pass safety and regression thresholds on curated evals before onboarding

next_steps:
Week 1: Finalize rubric and share with ENG/Design/Legal for feedback (owner: PM)
Week 2: Build PoC scoring microservice and minimal console hook (owner: ENG)
Week 3: Run internal intake on 5 historical requests to validate score distribution and tune weights (owner: PM + ENG)
Week 4: Ship docs + small rollout to beta customers and gather CS feedback (owner: PM)
Schedule: Cross-functional review on 2026-03-12

notes:
This ticket focuses on non-bug product work to reduce manual overhead for model catalog triage. The PoC should be lightweight and reversible; the primary deliverable is the playbook (human + automated steps) and a demonstrable integration into intake flows. If the scoring proves useful we'll iterate to a full service with audit logs and explainability features.
